Name: Simple Mouse Cursor
Author: HyperChicken01
Description:
[size=2][i]'I originally uploaded this to the Stardew Valley Forums, I decided to post it up here for anyone else, who doesn't have an account there or prefers this site.'[/i][/size]

One thing which never sat right with me was the in-game mouse cursor. It looked 'poppy' or '3D', but with the limited pixels, it just doesn't look right. So I edited them to look more clean and basic, a Windows-esque look. While they may not be within the game's artstyle, I still think they work well.


[u]Installation:[/u]

Navigate to your Stardew Valley Installation folder and copy file to:

Content/LooseSprites


Don't forget to make a backup of the original .xnb file before overwriting


[b]This edits cursors.xnb, so if you use any other mods that use the same file it will not be compatible, unless they are merged. [b]I will be happy to[b] merge this mod with any other[/b] if requested [/b]as long as I have permission with the original author.
